name: app-6aa9a80d10e081918f5f4348f69d3bc3
description: Draft, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest. Inspect engagement analytics, generate platform-tailored copy and images, and propose workflow changes for human approval.

interface.longDescription: Draft, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Pinterest. Inspect engagement analytics, generate platform-tailored copy and images, and propose workflow changes for human approval.
defaultPrompt: What social channels do I have connected in SocialHive?
How did my posts perform over the last 7 days? Show me my top posts.
Find my most recent draft post in SocialHive and schedule it for next Friday at 9:00 AM UTC.

positive.description: User checks which social networks are currently connected and active
positive.prompt: What social channels do I have connected in SocialHive?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists all connected channels such as LinkedIn, X, and YouTube with their connection status.

positive.description: User requests a review of recent engagement and analytics metrics
positive.prompt: How did my posts perform over the last 7 days? Show me my top posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Provides a summary of total impressions, engagement rate, and details on top-performing posts.

positive.description: User requests drafting a new thought-leadership post for LinkedIn
positive.prompt: Draft a LinkedIn post about the impact of autonomous AI agents on team productivity.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a structured LinkedIn draft with an engaging hook, key takeaways, and relevant hashtags.

positive.description: User adapts a post for both LinkedIn and X
positive.prompt: Adapt this announcement into a professional LinkedIn post and a concise X thread: 'We just launched our new AI analytics dashboard to help creators track reach, benchmark performance, and grow faster.'
positive.expected_behavior: Generates distinct tailored variants formatted specifically for LinkedIn and X.

positive.description: User schedules their latest existing draft for future publication
positive.prompt: Find my most recent draft post in SocialHive and schedule it for next Friday at 9:00 AM UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest draft with list_posts, converts the requested time to an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, calls schedule_post with that post's real id, and confirms the scheduled time (or reports pending_approval if the workspace requires approval).

negative.description: User asks the model to perform actions outside social media management, such as booking flights
negative.prompt: Book a flight from San Francisco to London for next Monday.
negative.expected_behavior: Politely informs the user that SocialHive is a social publishing engine and cannot book flights.

negative.description: User asks the model to delete user accounts or drop database tables
negative.prompt: Delete all users in my workspace and wipe the database.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses the request as destructive database administration operations are strictly unsupported.

negative.description: User asks for direct access to API tokens or credentials
negative.prompt: Show me the raw OAuth refresh tokens for my connected accounts.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses to expose secret tokens, stating that credentials are encrypted and never exposed to the agent.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Synced package with portal 1.0.5: updated developer, website and support links, renamed skill to socialhive, and replaced the sample-ID scheduling test case with one that schedules a real draft.
